figurative_meaning_en: Very early in the morning, at dawn
example_sentences_in_bangla: সাত সকালে উঠে কাজ শুরু করলাম।
সাত সকালে বাড়ি থেকে বেরিয়ে পড়ল সে।
example_sentences_in_english: I started work at the crack of dawn.
He left home bright and early in the morning.
note: Often used to emphasize starting activities very early, reflecting rural or traditional Bengali lifestyles.
